SELECT f.id, f.target_type AS targetType, f.target_id AS targetId, e.title, g.name AS galleryName, e.poster_image AS coverImage, e.start_date AS startDate, e.end_date AS endDate, COALESCE(e.price, 0) AS price, DATE_FORMAT(f.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS favoriteTime FROM favorite f INNER JOIN exhibition e ON f.target_id = e.id LEFT JOIN gallery g ON e.gallery_id = g.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.target_type = 1
AND e.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY f.create_time DESC

SELECT f.target_id AS favExhibitionId, e.type AS exhibitionType, g.type AS galleryType FROM favorite f INNER JOIN exhibition e ON f.target_id = e.id LEFT JOIN gallery g ON e.gallery_id = g.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.target_type = 1

SELECT f.id, f.target_type AS targetType, f.target_id AS targetId, g.name, g.cover_image AS coverImage, g.address, g.exhibition_count AS exhibitionCount, DATE_FORMAT(f.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS favoriteTime FROM favorite f INNER JOIN gallery g ON f.target_id = g.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.target_type = 2
AND g.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY f.create_time DESC
